WORK EXPERIANCE
Organization : Tata Consultancy Services
Client
: GSK ( Pharma Industry )
Role
: Support Project
Duration : Jan 2025 – Till Date
Roles and responsibilities:
➢ Resolving SAP Operational Issues related to Interface, Change Management, Process Change Management,
Including optimization of business process.
➢ Analyze and solve SAP tickets ( incidents, Service requests ).
➢ Monitor background jobs, IDocs, system logs, and transactions.
➢ Gather requirement for small enhancement and implement safely.
➢ Prepare user guids, how-to documents, and deliver training sessions.
➢

➢ Test changes thoroughly before moving to production.

to closing or escalation incidents.

➢ Good Experience in understanding EWM Business Processes and procedures, mapping those into

Organization : Source Engineering service india Pvt ltd.
Client
: Applied Materials India Pvt Ltd
Role
: Senior Configuration Engineer
Duration : Dec 2017 – July 2019
Roles and responsibilities:
➢
Create, configure and maintain product MBOM (Manufacturing BOM) & EBOM (Engineering BOM) structures
in Oracle ERP and Team center based on engineering, product planning and manufacturing requirements.
➢ Prepare platform level Master BOM in TCE structure manager which represent the released version of all
components, assemblies & kits for a specified platform and maintaining positional relationship of all the
components within the assembly model and preserve ownership on all product structures.Involved in the
Cutover Template Preparations and Execution
➢ Validate accuracy of Team center BOM against ERP BOM as well as 3D model integrity (UG Master).
➢ Validate and approve Engineering Change Orders by checking the accuracy of the scope, log issues for correctness
and align the ECO changes for product configuration in EBOM & MBOM structures.
➢ Engineering Change Management / Bill of Material(BoM) Management using SAP.
➢ Product Data Management (PDM) in Team center integrated with UG NX.
➢ Engineering Change Management processes.
Organization : EASI – Allegis Services Pvt Ltd
Client
: General Motors Technical Center (India)
Role
: Design Engineer
Duration : Oct 2010 – Dec 2017
Roles and responsibilities:
➢ Changing the existing CAD model as per the customer request.
➢
Importing the VSD file to newly created item in Teamcenter.
➢ Writing Assembly Procedure with Standard Verbs & uploading the image in GPIM.
➢ Create Work Standards and Instructions for the manufacturing process.
➢ Trouble shooting errors and resolving problems.
➢ Maintaining Bill of materials / Master Part list.
➢ Analyzing and implementing Workflow Development for Assembly procedure for parts.
➢
Implementing Lean manufacturing concepts to Assembly process to eliminate non value added activities.
➢ Peer reviewing the completed Drawing sheets with the help of GM Quality Check list.Supporting Pre Production
operations in plant.
